name: Brazil
shortSummary: Brazil and India are BRICS founding partners and co-members of the IBSA Dialogue Forum, cooperating closely on Global South advocacy including joint calls for UN Security Council reform.

majorAreasOfCooperation.description: Brazil supplies substantial edible oil and fertiliser volumes to India.
Joint coordination on UN reform, climate finance and trade positions.

recentDevelopments.title: Continued BRICS and G20 coordination
recentDevelopments.description: India and Brazil continued close coordination through BRICS and the G20 (Brazil hosted the G20 in 2024, following India's 2023 presidency), including joint advocacy for UN Security Council reform.
recentDevelopments.whyItMatters: Reflects a deepening Global South partnership beyond bilateral trade alone.

historicalEvents.title: IBSA Dialogue Forum Founded
historicalEvents.description: India, Brazil and South Africa launch the IBSA grouping to coordinate positions among major Global South democracies.

historicalEvents.title: Strategic Partnership
historicalEvents.description: India and Brazil elevate bilateral ties to a Strategic Partnership.

multilateralRelations.detail: Joint founding member alongside South Africa.
Joint advocacy for UN Security Council reform alongside Japan and Germany.
